boundary: Owner (LDO supplier): road tankers delivered to the unloading bays, tanker hoses and coupling halves on the tanker, first fill of the storage tanks (SC-055). Contractor: unloading bays, coupling halves on the plant side, pumps, metering, storage and treatment.
connection: Dry-break tanker coupling at the Contractor's unloading bays
isolation: Tanker bottom valve (supplier); Contractor unloading valve and ESD at each bay.
metering: Contractor unloading flow meter per bay; tanker delivery notes (Owner supplier).
operating_conditions: Up to 25 trucks/day (about 30 m3 each); 4 bays at about 100 m3/h each unloading pump set; LDO per TS EN 590 based specification.
owner_side: LDO supply contract (up to 25 trucks/day), first fill
protection: Contractor unloading pumps relief; bay earthing and overfill interlock (tanker earthing permissive).
size: 4 in tanker coupling (API RP 1004 bottom loading / dry-break)
